rentSupplyElasticity.source: Li (2022), "Do New Housing Units in Your Backyard Raise Your Rents?", Journal of Economic Geography: a 10% increase in housing stock within 500 ft lowers rents 1%.

alternate.source: Mense (2025), Journal of Political Economy Macroeconomics: 1% new housing supply lowers average rent 0.19%.

propertyTaxRate.source: Town of Chapel Hill FY2025-26 property tax rate: 50.0 cents per $100 of assessed value.

canopyMinPct.source: Chapel Hill Land Use Management Ordinance (LUMO) Section 5.7: tree canopy minimums of 20-40%.
canopyMinPct.note: Which value in that range applies to each zone state is our mapping, not the ordinance's. Forest counts as full canopy.

treesPerAcre.note: 33 matches the renderer's 11 m tree spacing. Not used by the metrics yet.

commuteDistancePenalty.note: Extra minutes for each new home in a map_edge zone. The town mean moves by the penalty times those homes' share of all homes.

agentScale.note: Real households per simulated household: 23,713 / 300. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentHouseholds.note: Simulated households per zone at year 0. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentUnits.note: Simulated homes per zone at year 0. New homes from policies are added to edge. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentBuildYears.note: Years over which new homes come online. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentGrowth.note: Baseline in-migration per year. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentInducedShare.note: Share of surplus vacancy that newcomers fill. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentInducedVacancy.note: Vacancy above which extra newcomers are drawn in. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentRentAmp.note: Strength of the rent response to vacancy. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentTargetVacancy.note: Vacancy at which rent holds steady. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentRentCurve.note: Shape and yearly limits of the rent-vs-vacancy curve. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentBurdenLine.note: Rent share of income above which a renter may leave. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentBurdenRise.note: Yearly rise in that share that counts toward leaving. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentLeaveProb.note: Chance of leaving after two such years in a row. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentRenterShare.note: From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentStudentShare.note: Share of renters who are students. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentIncomeMedian.note: Median household income by type (log-normal). From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentIncomeSpread.note: Log-normal spread of income by type. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentRemoteShare.note: From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentDurhamShare.note: Share of households working in Durham. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentCampusWorkShare.note: Of the rest, non-students working on campus (others work downtown). From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentZoneRent.note: Rent level by zone, before calibration to the ACS median gross rent. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentRentSpread.note: Each home's rent varies from min to min + range of its zone level. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentBaseCommuteMin.note: Local commute by zone, before calibration to the ACS mean commute. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

agentDurhamExtraMin.note: From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

roadT0Min.note: Free-flow 15-501 travel time. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

roadCapacity.note: 15-501 capacity. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

roadCarShare.note: Share of road users who drive. From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).

roadBpr.note: BPR delay curve: time = t0 x (1 + alpha x (volume/capacity)^beta). From the Chapel Hill Household Sim prototype (agents-prototype.js).
